scope: Byte-for-byte and PCM metadata audit of every enumerated race voice bank (all four selectable characters, six country opponents, EFFECTS), plus original Sound.ini powerup records 350..388 and ARMBEEP1..3. Availability does not prove an active native call. Native call-site audit is separate. No original game execution, browser decode, builds or broad test suite.

mixing.sourceDefaults: Source defaults: pitchPercent 0, pan 0, masterPercent 100 (49d300/49e0a0). Voice service passes loop=false (436760→49da60). Sound.ini field 2 controls preload/cache (49d3e0), not loop or priority.
mixing.namedGroups: 437560 applies RcrSound.ini [Volumes] in numeric order; shared weapon group writes finish at ITALIE 90.
mixing.effectSlider: 437e30 replaces FX-eligible source volume with FX_VOLUME; it does not multiply a second master gain. Enabled zero on load repairs to 75; runtime zero disables/clears queues.
mixing.spatial: 436760→436980 associates EFFECTS voice 10 with the player body, character voices with their racer body. Native 49da60 applies range cutoff, integer distance fade, DirectSound pan and relative velocity Doppler.
mixing.levelVolumePitch: Pickup/fire level chooses a recording, not an extra volume/pitch multiplier. Raw powerup records have volume 80, range 600, Doppler 80; enabled FX 100 overrides source volume to 100.
notes: Port sound-volume calculations matched all 12 retained native settings rows for each selected event; shared master remains100.
All 24 player/country combinations were constructed using the actual NativeVoiceController; every targeted admitted/missing EFFECTS sample matched the enumerated original bank.
No evidence of a separate Sound.ini priority field; playbackloop is a call argument. Character/effect queue ordering and replacement semantics remain a separate native call-site audit.
